Donald Trump has renewed his pledge to give every adult American a $5,000 payment if Republicans retain control of Congress in the 2026 midterm elections.  Trump described the proposal as a “Trump Dividend” in a post on Truth Social. Trump first announced the idea at the Republican Party’s first midterm convention in Dallas, arguing that the payments would come from increased economic activity and investment in the US.  However, details on how the scheme would work remain unclear, including whether it would be legally possible. With around 270 million adults in the US, a $5,000 payment for everyone would cost an estimated $1.35 trillion.  Trump has continued to insist that the payments will happen, while urging Americans to vote Republican in the midterms. #news #money #america #trump
